stages.name: soil_preparation
stages.objective: Create a fine, firm, weed-free seedbed with adequate moisture for uniform germination.
actions: Plough once with disc harrow or cultivator to 15-20 cm depth.
Apply well-decomposed FYM/compost at 8-10 t/acre.
Perform 2-3 passes of rotavator/cultivator to obtain fine tilth.
Form field into small plots and apply pre-sowing irrigation if soil is dry.
Apply basal fertilizer (DAP 50 kg or 10:26:26 65 kg/acre) based on soil test.
Treat seed with carbendazim 2g/kg + imidacloprid 3ml/kg for termite and smut control.
Level field using laser leveler to prevent water stagnation.
sustainable_alternatives: Zero tillage: direct sowing with Happy Seeder without ploughing (saves Rs.1500/acre).
Incorporate paddy straw instead of burning (saves Rs.2500/acre on FYM).
Use Trichoderma viride 4g/kg seed instead of chemical fungicide.

common_issues.organic_option: Apply extra FYM to improve tilth.
Mulch with paddy straw after sowing.
common_issues.preventive: Harvest previous crop early to conserve moisture.
Maintain soil moisture; avoid deep ploughing in dry conditions.

checkpoints: Soil moisture at 5 cm depth should form a ball when squeezed.

stages.name: sowing
stages.objective: Establish uniform plant stand at optimum depth and spacing for high yield potential.
actions: Sow from 1-15 November for Bihar/UP (earlier in Punjab/Haryana) to avoid terminal heat.
Use seed rate 35-40 kg/acre for timely sown; 45-50 kg for late sown.
Sow at row spacing 20-22.5 cm with seed drill or Happy Seeder.
Place seed 5-6 cm deep for better moisture access.
Apply first irrigation immediately after sowing if dry (not if using Happy Seeder with residual moisture).
Check seed meter calibration to avoid over/under population.
sustainable_alternatives: Broadcasting with paddy straw mulching (zero-till surface sowing) - cost Rs.500/acre.
Happy Seeder: sow into rice residue, saves tillage and conserves moisture.
Use farm-saved seed of improved variety after proper cleaning and treatment.

common_issues.remedy_cost_effective: Increase seed rate by 25%, use heat-tolerant varieties (e.g., HD-3086).
common_issues.organic_option: Apply jeevamrit to boost early vigor.
Mulching with straw (5 t/acre) suppresses weeds.

stages.name: crown_root_initiation_cri
stages.objective: Establish strong crown roots and initiate tillers for foundation of yield.
actions: Apply first irrigation at 20-25 DAS (Crown Root Initiation stage).
Top-dress with urea 35 kg/acre at CRI if soil is light.
Scout for aphids and powdery mildew.
Hand weed if any broadleaf weeds escape herbicide.
sustainable_alternatives: Apply jeevamrit (5%) through irrigation water for N (cost ~Rs.100/acre).
Use tensiometer to schedule irrigation (save water, cost neutral).
Incorporate Azolla as green manure in previous rice crop for residual N.

common_issues.remedy_cost_effective: Drain excess water, apply carbendazim drench.
common_issues.preventive: Avoid waterlogging; use raised bed planting.
Monitor soil moisture; irrigate at 20-25 DAS.

stages.name: tillering
stages.objective: Maximize productive tillers per plant to achieve target ear density.
actions: Apply second irrigation at active tillering (40-45 DAS).
Second top-dress urea 35 kg/acre if needed (based on LCC).
Monitor for yellow rust and brown rust.
Control broadleaf weeds with 2,4-D sodium salt 80% WP @ 250g/acre if needed.
Provide one hoeing if zero-tillage not used.
sustainable_alternatives: LCC-based N application (saves urea 25%, Rs.80/acre).
Cow urine spray (10%) as foliar N supplement (Rs.50/acre).
Use green manure (Sesbania) incorporation in previous kharif.

common_issues.organic_option: No effective organic; plant resistant variety HD-3226.
common_issues.preventive: Use resistant varieties; avoid late sowing.
Crop rotation with berseem or mustard.

common_issues.remedy_cost_effective: Skip further N, provide support by bunching.
common_issues.organic_option: Apply wood ash for K to strengthen stems.

checkpoints: No yellow rust pustules on leaves.

stages.name: jointing
stages.objective: Support rapid stem elongation and ear formation while protecting from biotic stress.
actions: Apply third irrigation at jointing (55-60 DAS).
Spray 0.2% manganese sulphate if soil is manganese deficient (alkaline soils).
Scout for brown rust and army worm.
Apply last dose of urea 18 kg/acre (if not applied earlier).
Support weak canopies with bamboo sticks if lodging risk.
sustainable_alternatives: Use wood ash (50 kg/acre) as K source for stem strength (Rs.100).
Wheat straw mulch to conserve moisture and reduce lodging.
Apply Panchagavya 3% for micronutrients.

common_issues.organic_option: No effective organic; use resistant varieties.

common_issues.preventive: Monitor soil moisture; irrigate at jointing.

checkpoints: No brown rust pustules on upper leaves.
Army worm larvae <2 per square meter.

stages.name: booting
stages.objective: Protect developing ear inside flag leaf sheath and ensure maximum spikelet fertility.
actions: Apply irrigation at booting (70-75 DAS) - critical for grain number.
Spray 0.2% Borax + 0.5% urea on flag leaf to boost grain set.
Scout for black rust and karnal bunt.
Maintain field hygiene, uproot off-type plants.
sustainable_alternatives: Seaweed extract 2ml/l as micronutrient supplement (Rs.150/acre).
Skip irrigation if soil moisture sufficient due to mulch.
Apply vermiwash 5% for trace elements.

symptoms: Black elongated pustules on stem and leaves
common_issues.organic_option: No effective organic; use resistant varieties.
No effective organic; use resistant vars (PBW-343).
common_issues.preventive: Use certified seed; seed treatment with carboxin.
Avoid very early sowing in frost-prone areas.

checkpoints: No black rust pustules on stem.

stages.name: heading_flowering
stages.objective: Achieve complete pollination and set maximum grains per ear.
actions: Maintain optimum soil moisture (light irrigation if dry).
Spray 2% DAP + 1% K foliar on flag leaf for grain fill.
Monitor for powdery mildew and aphids.
Avoid pesticide sprays that kill pollinators early morning.
Remove yellow/mosaic virus-affected plants.
sustainable_alternatives: Panchagavya spray 3% as floral biostimulant (Rs.75/acre).
Avoid all chemical sprays during active bee visitation.
Use fish amino acid 2ml/l for micronutrients.

common_issues.preventive: Use resistant varieties; avoid dense canopy.
Timely sowing to avoid heat at flowering.

symptoms: Black powder replacing ear (visible at heading)
common_issues.remedy_cost_effective: No control this season; use seed treatment next year.
common_issues.organic_option: Hot water seed treatment (52C for 10 min).
common_issues.preventive: Use certified seed; seed treatment with carboxin.

checkpoints: No powdery mildew on flag leaf.

stages.name: grain_filling
stages.objective: Maximize grain size and weight through optimal nutrition and protection.
actions: Irrigate at milk stage (about 105 DAS) - final irrigation.
Apply 2% potassium sulphate spray for grain hardiness.
Scout for pink stem borer and termites at base.
Install bird scaring ribbons to reduce grain loss.
sustainable_alternatives: Crop residue mulching reduces evaporation, might skip last irrigation.
Vermiwash 5% for grain filling (Rs.100/acre).
Apply wood ash extract for potassium.

common_issues.remedy_cost_effective: Harvest early if grain moisture drop fast.

checkpoints: Grains in milk to dough stage.

stages.name: maturity_harvest
stages.objective: Harvest wheat on time to avoid shattering and quality loss, and prepare for storage.
actions: Harvest when grains are hard (break clean when bitten) and moisture 14-16%.
Use combine harvester or sickle (manual) to cut crop near ground.
Thresh and clean grain immediately using thresher or manually.
Sun-dry grain to 10-12% moisture for safe storage.
Grade using sieve to remove shriveled grains.
sustainable_alternatives: Manual harvesting and threshing (low carbon, labor intensive).
Reaper binder attachment to tractor (rent ~Rs.800/acre).
Use pedal-operated thresher.

common_issues.remedy_cost_effective: Harvest at physiological maturity (grains hard, straw green-brown).
common_issues.preventive: Monitor crop daily after dough stage.

common_issues.remedy_cost_effective: Spread on tarpaulin, turn hourly, sun-dry.

stages.name: post_harvest_storage
stages.objective: Store grain safely to prevent moisture, pests and rodent damage for household consumption or market sale.
actions: Dry grain to 10-12% moisture (test by biting or moisture meter).
Clean grain thoroughly, remove admixture and weed seeds.
Fumigate storage structure with aluminum phosphide (expert only) or use neem leaves.
Store in HDPE/Jute bags on wooden pallets.
Monitor stored grain monthly for temperature, pests.
sustainable_alternatives: Hermetic storage bags (PICS bags) - no chemicals, reuseable (Rs.200/acre bag).
Diatomaceous earth (2 g/kg) as grain protectant.
Store with dried neem leaves as insect repellent.

common_issues.preventive: Clean storage area; use neem powder.

common_issues.remedy_cost_effective: Set traps, use zinc phosphide bait.

checkpoints: Bags stacked on pallets away from walls.

pest_calendar.ipm_action: Seed treatment with imidacloprid 3ml/kg; maintain soil moisture.
Encourage natural enemies (ladybird beetles); spray neem oil 5ml/l + soap.
Avoid waterlogging; use raised beds; seed treatment with Trichoderma.
Use resistant varieties (HD-2967, PBW-502); balanced N.
Early sowing; resistant varieties (HD-3226); avoid excessive N.
Install pheromone traps 3/acre; spray Bacillus thuringiensis.
Seed treatment with carboxin; resistant varieties.
Clean cultivation; remove previous stubbles; neem cake basal.
Natural enemies like ladybird beetles; neem oil 3%.
Field sanitation; remove weeds; barn owl posts.

sustainable_practices.practice: Zero-tillage wheat sowing with Happy Seeder
sustainable_practices.benefit: Conserves soil moisture, reduces fuel cost, prevents straw burning.
sustainable_practices.how_to: Sow directly into rice stubble using Happy Seeder attached to tractor.

sustainable_practices.benefit: Suppresses weeds, conserves moisture, adds organic matter.
sustainable_practices.how_to: Spread loose paddy straw evenly after sowing or use Happy Seeder.
Sow Sesbania with wheat, then knock down with 2,4-D at 25-30 DAS.

sustainable_practices.benefit: Reduces chemical fertilizer cost, improves soil carbon.
sustainable_practices.how_to: Replace 25% recommended NPK with well-decomposed FYM/compost.

sustainable_practices.practice: Balanced nitrogen using Leaf Color Chart (LCC)
sustainable_practices.benefit: Optimizes N use, reduces lodging and disease.
sustainable_practices.how_to: Match leaf color with LCC; apply urea only if color <4.

sustainable_practices.practice: IPM with pheromone traps for army worm
sustainable_practices.benefit: Reduces pesticide use, preserves natural enemies.
sustainable_practices.how_to: Install 3 pheromone traps per acre at jointing stage.

sustainable_practices.practice: Gypsum application for sodic soil reclamation
sustainable_practices.how_to: Apply 0.5 t/acre gypsum before last ploughing.

sustainable_practices.benefit: Saves irrigation water, improves nutrient use efficiency.
sustainable_practices.how_to: Use laser leveler once in 2-3 years.
Rotate wheat with chickpea, lentil, or mung bean.

sustainable_practices.practice: Seed treatment with Trichoderma / Bacillus subtilis
sustainable_practices.how_to: Treat seed with Trichoderma viride 4g/kg or Bacillus subtilis 10g/kg before sowing.

tools_and_machinery.purpose: Direct sowing into rice stubble with straw mulching

harvest_signals: Grain becomes hard - cannot be dented with thumbnail
Stem and leaves turn straw-colored and dry

storage_guidance.ambient_conditions: Cool, dry, well-ventilated room; avoid direct sunlight and moisture ingress.
storage_guidance.treatment_low_cost: Mix 2 kg neem powder per 100 kg grain; store on wooden pallets; use hermetic bags.

post_harvest_value_addition: Segregation of high-protein varieties for premium pricing
Durum wheat for semolina/ pasta market
Branding and marketing under Bihar Organic
Storage at FCI godowns for MSP procurement
sources: State Agriculture Universities (Bihar, Punjab, Haryana, MP, UP)
